    if fixed_facets is None:
        fixed_facets = set()

    n = {f: data[f].nunique() for f in facets_list}

        means = data.groupby(f)[metric].mean()

        cell_means = data.groupby([f1, f2])[metric].mean()
        n_per = N // (n[f1] * n[f2])

        f1_means = data.groupby(f1)[metric].mean()
        f2_means = data.groupby(f2)[metric].mean()
        for (l1, l2), cell_mean in cell_means.items():

        components[f"{f1}:{f2}"] = ss
